title: Princess Maani
routeNote: Route varies by season and departure
description: A 42 m, 14-cabin liveaboard for up to 28 guests, with two jacuzzis, a sun deck, cocktail bar and dedicated dive dhoni. Free Nitrox, kayaks and SUPs are available; routes range across central, northern and southern atolls.
priceNote: Our 7-night departures start at $2,688 per person; cabin, route and departure affect your final fare.

details.title: Princess Maani
details.overview: A multi-route liveaboard offering diving and snorkeling trips across the Maldives.
details.route: Our routes visit the central atolls, Hanifaru Bay, northern atolls and the deep south. We’ll confirm which itinerary and dive sites are available for your departure.
details.vessel: 42 m liveaboard with 14 cabins for up to 28 guests, two jacuzzis and a dedicated dive dhoni.
includes: Airport transfer on scheduled cruise dates
Kayaks, stand-up paddleboards and beach barbecue
activities: Guided diving across the selected route; dive sites vary by itinerary
Hanifaru Bay manta snorkeling on the Manta Madness itinerary
Kayaking, stand-up paddleboarding and beach barbecues
Massage services are available at an additional cost
details.transfers: Airport transfers are included on scheduled departure dates. We’ll confirm your meeting point and any extra transfer costs if you’re traveling outside the scheduled dates.
details.priceBasis: Our 7-night Princess Maani departures start at USD 2,688 per person. Cabin and route affect the fare; green tax, fuel surcharge, service charge and some park fees may be extra. Send us your dates and we’ll confirm availability and your full trip total.
importantNotes: Choose from departures ranging from 7 to 11 nights, with routes varying by season.
We’ll outline any green tax, fuel surcharge, service charge and park fees in your quote before you book.
Marine-life sightings vary by route and season and can’t be guaranteed.

title: Princess Haseena
description: A 32 m Maldivian-built liveaboard with 12 cabins, 13 bathrooms and three decks. Princess Haseena combines solar energy and battery storage with diesel generation for a future-ready diving safari.
priceNote: Cabin configuration, itinerary and departure affect availability and the final fare.

details.title: Princess Haseena
details.overview: Princess Haseena is Top Class Cruising’s future-ready Maldivian-built liveaboard, renovated in 2026.
details.route: Maldives liveaboard itineraries are confirmed according to the selected departure. Exact routes and dive sites vary.
details.vessel: 32 m, 10.8 m beam, 12 cabins across three decks, 13 bathrooms and accommodation for 24/26 guests.
activities: Guided diving from a dedicated diving vessel
Beach barbecues and al fresco dining
details.transfers: Transfer arrangements are confirmed when you request your preferred departure.
details.priceBasis: Please send us your preferred dates, cabin configuration and number of guests for a current Princess Haseena quote. The quoted total may vary with departure and itinerary.
importantNotes: Princess Haseena was built in the Maldives in 2016 and renovated in 2026.
Cabins range across the lower, main and upper decks, with flexible double, twin and family configurations.
The vessel uses solar energy, battery storage and diesel generation to improve onboard energy use.
A new 15 m diving dhoni with four electric motors and solar-assisted battery propulsion was under construction, according to the vessel page.
